entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Isaac. I... I think I need to return something. I'm a bit lost with the whole process on your website. It's all so confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm happy to walk you through it. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF8871-045. It's a helmet I bought a while back. I just get so overwhelmed with these things.
No problem at all. Let me pull up VF8871-045 for you. Okay, I see it here. It's for the Aero-Dynamic Road Helmet. And it looks like it was delivered about 45 days ago. Is that correct?

Yes, that sounds right. The color just wasn't what I expected from the pictures online. I never even took it out, so the box is unopened. All the safety seals are still there. I just... I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course. Let me just double-check our return policy for you. One moment... Okay, yes. Our policy states you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. Since you're at 45 days, you are well within the window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. Thank you.

It's my pleasure. And I see here that you're one of our VIP members. Since you had some trouble with the website and the helmet color wasn't quite right, I'm going to email you a pre-paid return shipping label so you don't have to worry about any costs. I'll also add a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Wow, you don't have to do that! That's so kind. Thank you, Isaac. You've made this so much easier for me.

You're very welcome. I'm sending that email with the label now. Just print it, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the unopened box, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
Happy to assist. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
